description: Common TDS sections for society vendor payments, used only to check that a TDS amount corresponds to a recognised rate. Which section applies to a given vendor, thresholds, PAN availability (higher rate) and lower-deduction certificates are company/tax-advisor policy: TDS_SECTION_POLICY is POLICY_REQUIRED.

sections.nature: Fees for professional or technical services

rules.text: TDS is normally computed on the value excluding GST when GST is shown separately on the invoice.
TDS cannot exceed the taxable value.
Without a valid PAN, TDS is deducted at a higher rate (commonly 20%).
